system.description:
HEALER

Your mastery of healing magic strengthens the restorative power of your spells, allowing you to remove greater afflictions.
When you use Restorative Hands, the amount by which the selected condition is reduced increases according to the PP required to cast the triggering spell:
Fatigued or Sickened: Reduce by 1 per complete 2 PP spent (for example, a 4 PP spell reduces the condition by 2 instead of 1).
Dazed or Weakened: Reduce by 1 per complete 4 PP spent (for example, an 8 PP spell reduces the condition by 2 instead of 1).
Injured: Reduce by 1 per complete 6 PP spent (for example, a 12 PP spell reduces the condition by 2 instead of 1).
Soul Drain: Reduce by 5 per complete 8 PP spent (for example, a 16 PP spell reduces Soul Drain by 10 instead of 5).
Doomed: Reduce by 1 per complete 10 PP spent (for example, a 20 PP spell reduces Doomed by 2 instead of 1).

Prerequisites Medicine 4 ranks

Works through Restorative Hands: the reduction scales with the PP entered.
